title: Steer a sampler with classifier-free guidance
brief: Drop the condition during training, combine a conditional and an unconditional prediction in both guidance conventions, and watch guidance move and narrow a distribution of notes.
hints: drop_condition: build a boolean mask with rng.random(len(cond)) < p, then use np.where(mask[:, None], null, cond).
cfg_combine is one line: (1 + w) * cond - w * uncond.
cfg_combine_s starts from the unconditional prediction and walks s times the gap toward the conditional one.
guided_denoiser returns a function of (x, sigma) that calls both denoisers and combines them.
